methodologyNotes: The roster covers 10 high-search countertop/personal blender models spanning budget to premium, all currently sold or recently available in the US. Independently re-verified 2026-06-15 against official manufacturer pages (vitamix.com, sharkninja.com/ninjakitchen.com, nutribullet.com, breville.com, blendtec.com, oster.com) and major retail/review listings (Walmart, Amazon, Best Buy, Home Depot, Sur La Table, RTINGS). Motor wattage is rated continuous draw unless labeled 'peak' in the provenance; several models (Ninja, Oster, KitchenAid, Cleanblend) publish PEAK watts only and are flagged as such. dishwasher_safe reflects whether the main jar/pitcher (not the motor base, not the blade assembly) is dishwasher-safe per manufacturer. noise_dampening reflects a built-in acoustic enclosure / integrated sound-suppression system (not optional accessories); no model in this list ships with a full enclosure, so all are false. warranty_years reflects the STANDARD included full/limited warranty (NOT extended drive-only warranties). Prices are US MSRP or current typical retail price in USD. NULL is used wherever a value could not be corroborated. accessedAt 2026-06-15.
